answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31925 Country: India Title: Now a days photograph system has been started for proposals which has crept into my society also?what do you say . Question: Now a days photograph system has been started for proposals which has crept into my society also?what do you say ..Should we give the Photograph? What is the procedure according to islam if a boy wants to see a girl? Answer ID: 31925 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! It is not allowable to give and take photographs for nikah; this is not an Islamic way. The hadith warns sternly those who make pictures. Finalizing a proposal is not one among the unavoidable conditions where photograph was regarded allowable. The boy can get information through his female family members. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
